ndf7c39dabc.headline: Barrick Gold Changing Name to Barrick Mining, NYSE Symbol to 'B' From 'GOLD'
ndf7c39dabc.summary: Canadian miner Barrick Gold is dropping 'gold' from its name, reflecting the growing importance of copper in its portfolio, and will change its NYSE symbol from GOLD to B.
ndf7c39dabc.why: Barrick is one of the world's largest gold miners, and its copper exposure is increasingly relevant to investors tracking metals portfolios.

n7b34365aec.headline: Iran port blast death toll rises to at least 46, with more than 1,000 injured
n7b34365aec.summary: The death toll from an explosion at an Iranian port rose to at least 46, with more than 1,000 people injured. A fire was still burning at the site two days after the blast.
n7b34365aec.why: Major ports are critical trade gateways, so disruptions to their operations can affect shipping, freight rates and regional supply chains.

n9e1c6b3904.headline: Carrefour Q1 FY25 performance matches outlook
n9e1c6b3904.summary: Shareholders approved the purchase of the remaining Carrefour Brasil shares not owned by the group. Carrefour's Q1 FY25 performance was reported to match its outlook.
n9e1c6b3904.why: Carrefour is a French retail group with large operations in Brazil, and changes to its ownership of Carrefour Brasil affect its local retail business.

nd32e2ad213.headline: Lidl announces plans to open more than 40 new stores across the UK
nd32e2ad213.summary: Lidl plans to open more than 40 new stores across the UK this financial year. Locations were listed from Ellon to Dawlish and Builth Wells to Aylsham.
nd32e2ad213.why: Lidl is a German discount grocer, and store expansion signals competitive pressure in the UK supermarket sector.

ndb66333c94.headline: Naftogaz Keeps Gas Prices Unchanged for Another Year
ndb66333c94.summary: Naftogaz will continue supplying natural gas to Ukrainian households at the current regulated rate until April 2026, reflecting a moratorium on raising gas tariffs.
ndb66333c94.why: Naftogaz is Ukraine's state-owned gas company, and regulated household gas tariffs affect its revenues and the country's energy budget.

n1808286725.headline: Brazil to offer tax breaks to lure data center investments, sources say
n1808286725.summary: Finance Minister Fernando Haddad will travel to Silicon Valley with a plan to exempt data center technology investments from taxes to attract such projects to Brazil.
n1808286725.why: Data centers require large capital investment and power, and tax incentives can determine where cloud and AI infrastructure is built.

nde42a2c51b.headline: Singapore negotiating for US concessions on pharmaceuticals, chips - AOL
nde42a2c51b.summary: Singapore is negotiating for US concessions on pharmaceuticals and chips, while US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick raised concerns about chip export controls.
nde42a2c51b.why: Singapore is a major trade hub for semiconductors and pharmaceuticals, so US export and tariff rules directly affect its trade.

nb8b3815b4b.headline: EY Item Club slashes UK growth forecasts
nb8b3815b4b.summary: The EY Item Club downgraded its UK economic growth expectations for this year and next. It cited trade disruption and persistent inflation.
nb8b3815b4b.why: The EY Item Club is a UK economic forecasting group whose growth outlooks are widely followed by businesses, lenders and investors pricing UK assets.

n31dd6f3ae7.headline: Domino's Pizza US sales dip as inflation, economic uncertainty hurt demand
n31dd6f3ae7.summary: Domino's Pizza posted a surprise first-quarter decline in same-store sales in its biggest market, the US. Elevated inflation and economic uncertainty hit consumer demand for restaurant food.
n31dd6f3ae7.why: Domino's is a US-listed pizza chain whose same-store sales are a key gauge of consumer restaurant spending. Its results are closely watched by investors tracking discretionary demand.
n31dd6f3ae7.why_moved: A surprise drop in same-store sales in the largest market signals weaker demand than expected, which typically prompts investors to reassess the company's near-term earnings outlook.

n7e53cc3116.headline: CBN focusing on bringing down inflation — Cardoso
n7e53cc3116.summary: Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Olayemi Cardoso reiterated that the apex bank's focus is on bringing down the country's inflation. The remarks were reported by Daily Post Nigeria.
n7e53cc3116.why: The central bank sets monetary policy and interest rates, which drive naira asset valuations and bond yields. Inflation direction is central to investor assessments of Nigerian assets.

nc1e09dc3ae.headline: Woodside Posts $3.32B Revenue for Q1
nc1e09dc3ae.summary: Woodside's first-quarter revenue fell five percent from the prior three-month period to $3.32 billion. The decline was primarily due to lower production and weaker oil-linked prices.
nc1e09dc3ae.why: Woodside is an Australian LNG and oil producer whose revenues track production volumes and oil and gas prices. Its results are a read-across for Australian energy exports.

n441ef9ae76.headline: Friedrich Merz picks pro-Kyiv foreign minister and promises German support for Ukraine
n441ef9ae76.summary: Chancellor-designate Friedrich Merz appointed Johann Wadephul, an ex-soldier, as foreign minister. Merz vowed to tackle Russian aggression and promised German support for Ukraine.
n441ef9ae76.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, so its foreign and defence policy shapes European security spending and sanctions policy that affect markets.

nb0640cc187.headline: Students and hire staff pay for Labor election pledges
nb0640cc187.summary: Labor has set out how it would balance the federal budget while funding its election promises. A global agency has warned about the fiscal position as the pledges are costed.
nb0640cc187.why: Government budget balance and election spending commitments shape sovereign borrowing needs and fiscal policy in Australia. Investors watch these plans for their effect on bond supply and inflation.

ncc2ef0fd08.headline: Major power outage in Spain and Portugal knocks out subway networks, traffic lights and ATMs
ncc2ef0fd08.summary: A blackout brought much of Spain and Portugal to a standstill on Monday, halting subway and rail services, cutting phone service, and shutting traffic lights and ATMs for millions of people.
ncc2ef0fd08.why: Large power outages disrupt transport, payments and commerce, and they raise questions for investors about grid resilience and the economic cost to affected economies.

n527e92c2d8.headline: NACCIMA, OPS worry over World Bank’s 56 per cent poverty rise projection for 2027, offers short-term measures to reverse trend
n527e92c2d8.summary: The Nigerian Association of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture and the Organised Private Sector expressed concern over a World Bank projection of a 56 per cent poverty rise for 2027. They offered short-term measures to reverse the trend.
n527e92c2d8.why: Poverty and household income trends shape consumer demand, policy choices and the economic outlook for emerging markets such as Nigeria.

n33bfa41832.headline: Castrol India's first quarter profit climbs on stronger engine oil demand
n33bfa41832.summary: Castrol India reported an 8% rise in first-quarter profit on Monday, driven by growing demand for its engine oil and lubricants. The company is majority-owned by its parent.
n33bfa41832.why: Castrol India is a listed lubricants producer whose results offer a read on domestic automotive and industrial demand in India.

nbe166462dd.headline: Power cuts in Spain and Portugal cause major disruptions affecting millions
nbe166462dd.summary: A major power cut hit Spain and Portugal on Monday, April 28, causing major disruptions to millions of people.
nbe166462dd.why: Widespread grid failures disrupt industry, transport and commerce, and raise questions about electricity system reliability.

n204782ffda.headline: Spain and Portugal power outage causes chaos, trains halted and flights delayed
n204782ffda.summary: A power outage spread across Spain and Portugal, including Madrid and Lisbon, causing trains to halt and flights to be delayed.
n204782ffda.why: Iberia's electricity grid underpins transport, industry and services, so large outages disrupt economic activity.

n6729a0b7a0.headline: Delegat Group cuts 2025 profit guidance due to US tariff impact
n6729a0b7a0.summary: Delegat Group cut its operating net profit after tax guidance to $47-50 million for the year ending 30 June, citing US tariffs.
n6729a0b7a0.why: Delegat is a New Zealand wine producer whose sales are heavily exposed to export markets, including the United States.

nc0c5ed5de4.headline: Deliveroo suspends buyback after £2.7m DoorDash proposal
nc0c5ed5de4.summary: Deliveroo suspended its £100 million share buyback after receiving a 180p per share takeover proposal from US rival DoorDash, announced on Monday.
nc0c5ed5de4.why: Deliveroo is a London-listed food delivery platform, and DoorDash is a major US food delivery company.
nc0c5ed5de4.why_moved: Deliveroo received a 180p per share takeover proposal from DoorDash and suspended its buyback programme in response.

na95077cc48.headline: Matilda Asante-Asiedu appointed BoG 2nd Deputy Governor
na95077cc48.summary: President John Mahama has appointed Matilda Asante-Asiedu as the Second Deputy Governor of the Bank of Ghana. The appointment concerns the central bank's senior leadership.
na95077cc48.why: The Bank of Ghana is the central bank that sets monetary policy and oversees the banking system in Ghana.

ne1b3da0ce7.headline: China's Sinopec partners with Saudi Aramco's unit in $4 billion JV
ne1b3da0ce7.summary: China's state-run Sinopec said on Monday it signed an agreement with a unit of Saudi Aramco to form a joint venture with registered capital of 28.80 billion yuan.
ne1b3da0ce7.why: Sinopec is one of China's largest state-owned oil refiners and petrochemical producers, and Saudi Aramco is the world's largest crude oil exporter. Their partnerships shape global energy supply and refining.

n51f93a586a.headline: Cadence Bank seals deal to buy Industry Bancshares
n51f93a586a.summary: Cadence Bank has signed a deal to acquire Industry Bancshares, which operates 27 full-service branches in Central and Southeast Texas.
n51f93a586a.why: Regional bank consolidation changes competitive dynamics, deposit franchises and capital needs for US lenders and their shareholders.

ncc4cc14cf2.headline: Blackout stricken Spain declares state of emergency amid panic-buying and gridlock which could last for days
ncc4cc14cf2.summary: Spain's Interior Ministry declared a state of emergency after a mass power outage affected parts of Spain and Portugal. Reports describe panic-buying and gridlock.
ncc4cc14cf2.why: The IBEX 35 is Spain's benchmark stock index, and power disruptions affect businesses, logistics and the broader economy. Grid stability is critical for industry and utilities.
ncc4cc14cf2.why_moved: A mass power outage affected parts of Spain and Portugal, leading to a state of emergency and gridlock, which disrupts economic activity.

n1591f5287d.headline: Energy prices could fall from July, lowering bills for millions
n1591f5287d.summary: Household energy bills may fall in July after US trade tariffs caused a slump in global gas prices, according to the report. The article links the decline to tariff-driven market weakness.
n1591f5287d.why: Gas prices feed into UK household energy bills through the regulated price cap, so wholesale gas moves affect consumer inflation and utility revenues.

n6c3263408c.headline: Etihad Airways shrugs off tariff turmoil, sees opportunities
n6c3263408c.summary: Abu Dhabi's Etihad Airways is not seeing effects from the turmoil caused by US tariff policies, CEO Antonoaldo Neves told Reuters. He said the airline sees opportunities.
n6c3263408c.why: Etihad is the national carrier of the United Arab Emirates, and airline demand and costs are sensitive to trade and travel conditions.

na0f4649952.headline: EUR/USD Forecast: Euro Softens Amid ECB Rate Cut in June
na0f4649952.summary: EUR/USD traded in the mid-1.13 area, with the euro softening amid a rising likelihood of another European Central Bank rate cut in June.
na0f4649952.why: The EUR/USD pair is the most traded currency pair globally, and expectations for European Central Bank rate decisions drive its moves.

nef9637c300.headline: GPs warn a £290m funding gap threatens the future of NHS Scotland
nef9637c300.summary: BMA Scotland warned that a £290 million funding gap threatens NHS Scotland. GPs say they cannot afford to hire more staff to cope with rising demand.
nef9637c300.why: Public health funding gaps shape government spending priorities and the pressure on healthcare budgets in Scotland.

nc7f63300f1.headline: Eurostar voices concerns as it calls on rivals to invest in depot facilities
nc7f63300f1.summary: Eurostar is calling on rival operators to invest in new depot facilities if they wish to end its monopoly on cross-Channel rail services. The operator says it has voiced concerns about the issue.
nc7f63300f1.why: Eurostar runs high-speed passenger trains between London, Paris and Brussels through the Channel Tunnel, so access to depots and rolling stock shapes competition on that route.

n490e795727.headline: Saudi Arabia, Qatar to settle Syria’s World Bank debt
n490e795727.summary: Saudi Arabia and Qatar plan to settle Syria's World Bank debt. It would be the first known Saudi financing for Syria since rebels toppled Bashar al-Assad.
n490e795727.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose arrears can block a country's access to development finance and reconstruction funding.

nacb3cc96c2.headline: China approves construction of ten new nuclear reactors
nacb3cc96c2.summary: China has approved ten new nuclear reactors and currently has 30 under construction, almost half the total worldwide.
nacb3cc96c2.why: Nuclear power plant construction is capital-intensive and involves state utilities and reactor equipment suppliers. Large approvals signal long-term energy investment.

na09e78e972.headline: M&S tells agency warehouse staff to stay at home after cyber attack
na09e78e972.summary: Marks and Spencer has stopped taking orders from its website and app for a fourth day after a cyber attack, and has told agency warehouse staff to stay home.
na09e78e972.why: Marks and Spencer is a major UK retailer with large food and clothing sales, so online disruption affects its revenue and operations.

n00c4e12517.headline: US sanctions hit ships delivering oil, gas to Houthi rebels
n00c4e12517.summary: The US Treasury has sanctioned ships delivering oil and gas to Houthi rebels, with officials saying the action aims to disrupt funding for attacks in the region.
n00c4e12517.why: US Treasury sanctions can restrict shipping, insurance and banking access. Disruption to Red Sea shipping routes affects global freight and energy flows.

nafce8ac6ee.headline: US fund managers cut corners at Australian daycares for bigger profits
nafce8ac6ee.summary: Childcare operator Only About Children, owned by US fund managers, is reported to have cut corners in Sydney and Melbourne centres to boost profits.
nafce8ac6ee.why: Private equity ownership of childcare providers can prioritise returns, which affects service quality, regulation and investor exposure to the sector.

n783a9e5c9d.headline: Ringgit ends at over five-month high vs US dollar amid tariff-talk optimism
n783a9e5c9d.summary: The ringgit rebounded against the US dollar to finish at more than a five-month high, amid encouraging tariff talks between Malaysia and the US government.
n783a9e5c9d.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its value affects the cost of imports and the competitiveness of the country's export-heavy economy.

n982cfed186.headline: How to avoid credit card late fees after a court threw out a proposed cap
n982cfed186.summary: A Texas judge has thrown out a federal rule that would have capped credit card late fees at $8. The ruling removes a proposed limit on fees charged to cardholders.
n982cfed186.why: Credit card late fees are a significant revenue source for card issuers such as major U.S. banks. Federal consumer finance rules shape the profitability of consumer lending.

n8b8fe924f2.headline: CtrlS Datacenters to invest Rs 500 crore for greenfield data centre in Bhopal
n8b8fe924f2.summary: CtrlS Datacenters will invest Rs 500 crore in a greenfield AI-ready data centre in Bhopal. At full capacity, it is expected to contribute Rs 7.5 crore annually each to SGST and CGST.
n8b8fe924f2.why: CtrlS is an Indian data-centre operator, and such capital projects reflect demand for cloud and AI computing capacity. Data-centre investment also brings tax revenue to host states.

n8f4997b7f9.headline: Trump needs unity among Republicans to pass his budget bill. Can he get it?
n8f4997b7f9.summary: Congress returns from a two-week recess with budget reconciliation on its agenda. Lawmakers barely passed the plan's framework along party lines and face an uphill battle on consensus.
n8f4997b7f9.why: Budget reconciliation sets federal spending and tax policy, which affects the fiscal outlook, Treasury issuance and sector-level expectations.

n9dcc11ac69.headline: Europe open: Stoxx up with Mediobanca Generali bid in focus
n9dcc11ac69.summary: Italy's Mediobanca unveiled a €6.3bn bid for rival Banca Generali on Monday. European shares made a strong start to the week as the bid drew attention.
n9dcc11ac69.why: Mediobanca is a Milan-listed Italian investment bank, and Banca Generali is an Italian private banking and wealth manager. Bank consolidation can reshape Italian financial sector competition.

impacts.name: Mediobanca
impacts.why: Mediobanca is the company making the €6.3bn bid, so it carries the cost and strategic risk of the offer.

n16f16f8591.headline: America's Consumers Say They Feel Down, But Keep Spending Anyway
n16f16f8591.summary: Investors are watching the first estimate of US first-quarter GDP and April jobs data this week, alongside a Bank of Japan decision.
n16f16f8591.why: US GDP and jobs data are key gauges of economic growth and labour market strength, which influence Federal Reserve policy and asset prices.

n450ff78580.headline: USD/CAD Outlook: Caution Prevails as Canada Awaits Election
n450ff78580.summary: Forex Crunch describes the USD/CAD outlook as neutral, with traders cautious ahead of Canada's general election results. The pair's near-term direction is seen as undecided.
n450ff78580.why: The Canadian dollar is a major commodity-linked currency, and election outcomes can shift expectations for fiscal policy and the Bank of Canada.

impacts.name: USD/CAD
impacts.why: Traders are cautious about the pair ahead of the Canadian election result, so its direction is unclear.

n7de2c60fa3.headline: Data centres are emerging in Negeri Sembilan
n7de2c60fa3.summary: Negeri Sembilan is emerging as a new data centre hub as Johor, the top market, grapples with the facilities' heavy energy and water consumption.
n7de2c60fa3.why: Data centres drive demand for power, water and land, and Malaysia has become a key Asian location for cloud and AI infrastructure. Capacity constraints in one state can redirect investment to neighbouring regions.

n14ccd2e6ae.headline: Pakistan has reached ‘pivotal moment’ of economic recovery: finance minister
n14ccd2e6ae.summary: Finance Minister Aurangzeb outlined key economic achievements in a conference at Harvard University, saying Pakistan has reached a pivotal moment of economic recovery.
n14ccd2e6ae.why: Statements by a finance minister signal government policy direction and can influence investor views on Pakistan's macroeconomic stability and reform progress.

nea35f7cf67.headline: Japan PM goes to Vietnam, Philippines to talk tariffs
nea35f7cf67.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba left for a four-day trip to Vietnam and the Philippines to discuss tariffs.
nea35f7cf67.why: Japan is a major exporter and trading partner in Asia, so tariff arrangements affect its manufacturers and regional supply chains. Investors track these talks for trade-policy shifts.

nd60d85229b.headline: Rupee rises 12 paise to 85.29 against US dollar in early trade
nd60d85229b.summary: The rupee gained 12 paise to 85.29 against the US dollar in early trade. Rising forex reserves are supporting India's import cover amid geopolitical tensions.
nd60d85229b.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets.

n80ae1510c0.headline: Indus Motor profit after tax jumps 75% in 9 months of FY25
n80ae1510c0.summary: Indus Motor Company posted profit after tax of Rs16.55 billion in the first nine months of FY25. The result represents a 75% jump year on year.
n80ae1510c0.why: Indus Motor assembles Toyota vehicles in Pakistan, so its results reflect the health of the local auto market.

n479c5f19a0.headline: Bangladesh's remittance inflow shines bright with $2.27bn in April's 26 days
n479c5f19a0.summary: Bangladesh received $2.27 billion in remittances in the first 26 days of April 2025. The flow continued strongly after the Eid celebrations, according to UNB.
n479c5f19a0.why: Remittances from overseas workers are a major source of foreign currency for Bangladesh. They support the taka, foreign reserves and household consumption.

n18eb566e7a.headline: SBP likely to cut key policy rate by 50bps to 11.5%, brokerage house says
n18eb566e7a.summary: A brokerage expects the State Bank of Pakistan's monetary policy committee to cut the key policy rate by 50 basis points to 11.5%. The decision was expected at the committee's meeting.
n18eb566e7a.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets the benchmark interest rate that drives borrowing costs and inflation expectations. Rate decisions affect bonds, the rupee and bank lending.

n11f049c81b.headline: Mark Carney’s Liberal Party wins a Canadian election upended by Trump
n11f049c81b.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's Liberal Party won Canada's federal election on Monday. The result followed a campaign shaped by U.S. President Donald Trump's annexation threats and trade war.
n11f049c81b.why: Canada's federal government sets fiscal, trade and regulatory policy, so its direction matters for businesses exposed to U.S. trade relations.

ncb442b5808.headline: European stocks rise; FTSE 100 notches best winning streak in over 5 years
ncb442b5808.summary: European markets opened higher, with investors awaiting major earnings and data releases in Europe and the U.S.
ncb442b5808.why: Market movements reflect investor sentiment and economic outlooks in Europe, impacting global financial conditions.

nb41faffb21.headline: Rupee traders to track Kashmir attack developments, local equities
nb41faffb21.summary: Indian rupee remains flat as traders monitor regional tensions and U.S. economic data.
nb41faffb21.why: Currency movements are sensitive to geopolitical tensions and macroeconomic data, affecting trade and investment flows.

necf4c5c866.headline: Big two need to move forward
necf4c5c866.summary: China has established itself as the world's second-largest economy, with GDP reaching about 134% of the global total in 2024.
necf4c5c866.why: China's economic size influences global trade, investment, and geopolitical dynamics, affecting markets worldwide.

n3a9a61216c.headline: 365.bank reduces interest rates on mortgages with one- and three-year fixations
n3a9a61216c.summary: 365.bank lowered its one-year fixed mortgage rate to 3.55% from 4.35%. Its three-year fixed rate was cut to 3.55% from 3.75%.
n3a9a61216c.why: Mortgage pricing by Slovak lenders shapes household borrowing costs and demand in the housing market, and reflects banks' funding and competitive conditions.
